core: Issue description convention E/O; Best binary-eo-v3 unchanged
v0: D1..D18 DEVELOPMENT_GUARD_FAIL retained as FAIL; never rescored with the v1 guard

budget.countsOnly: new v1 provider calls; historical cost total UNKNOWN

noise.measurement: one Best-versus-Best rerun of the 626 D626 BestE requests with request wire identical to the retained D18 BestE wire
noise.pair: rerun answer versus retained D18 BestE answer for the same case
noise.rate: f/n: n = cases where both answers are qualified yes/no, f = those whose answers differ

rMax: ceil(f * C / n), C = cases where fresh Best is correct in the evaluated comparison; computed per development run and per held pass
developmentGuard: all physical qualified AND model stable AND repaired > regressed AND regressed <= rMax; regressed counts only fresh Best-correct cases broken; no ever-correct union
heldAcceptance: exactly two passes over the same unused held cases; each pass: all qualified AND model stable AND common-Gold delta lower bound > 0 AND regressed <= rMax; both passes AND, no averaging
stageInput: admission: sum of per-post estimates <= remaining input; a request identical to a retained one uses its retained actual input, a new wire uses ceil(wireChars * sum retained inputTokens / sum retained wireChars); runtime: before each post stop if counted input + estimate > remaining, after each post count actual input_tokens or the estimate when unknown
